This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation II|second generation]] games {{2v2|Gold|Silver}} for the [[Game Boy Color]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]]. All names are given in Western order.
